Lemma
[Brezis--Merle exponential estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0081 1. ch28:28.50\group Finite Width

For $w\in C^{2,\alpha }(\overline{B(r)})$ vanishing on the boundary and $0<\delta <4\pi $, \[ \int _{B(r)}\exp \! \left(\frac{\delta |w|}{\| \Delta w\| _{L^1}}\right)d\mu _E \le \frac{16\pi ^2r^2}{4\pi -\delta }. \]
